embedding_policy.default: Do not embed historical uploads directly in the museum origin.
embedding_policy.preferred_presentation: Screenshot, metadata, verified claims and a separately hosted clean-room restoration.
embedding_policy.interactive_origin: Use a separate origin with no shared authentication or storage.

embedding_policy.sensitive_content: Present health-adjacent artifacts as historical software, not clinical tools.
